Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 6: the slip of [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“[Pilot] 2. During your control phase (twice if aboard Devastator), may use 1 force to ▲ an Imperial pilot of ability < 3.”), word for word the text of [[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
